definition: Content intelligence is a method that uses artificial intelligence systems and software algorithms to analyze data content.
details: AI analyzes customer and client behavior, while the software processes vast amounts of data to provide insights into content trends, efficiency, and sentiment analysis.
story: Think of a historian sorting through boxes of letters, building a picture of an era one sentence at a time. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. The examples a machine reads become the world it believes in. The words a model reads become the world it believes in. That care with the raw material is Content intelligence.
